questions.question: Find the next term in the series: B3D, F6H, J9L, N12P, ?
questions.explanation: Answer: A The pattern involves increasing each letter by 4 positions and each number by 3: B3D (B + 4) (3+3) (D+4) = F6H (F + 4) (6+3) (H+4) = J9L (J + 4) (9+3) (L+4) = N12P (N + 4) (12+3) (P+4) = R15T Therefore, the next term is "R15T".

hi.question: श्रृंखला में अगला पद ज्ञात कीजिए: B3D, F6H, J9L, N12P, ?
hi.explanation: उत्तर: A इस पैटर्न में प्रत्येक अक्षर को 4 स्थान और प्रत्येक संख्या को 3 स्थान बढ़ाना शामिल है: B3D (B + 4) (3+3) (D+4) = F6H (F + 4) (6+3) (H+4) = J9L (J + 4) (9+3) (L+4) = N12P (N + 4) (12+3) (P+4) = R15T इसलिए, अगला पद "R15T" है।
